title: Weddings, Corporate & Private Events
subtitle: Scenic settings for every celebration
description:
We offer a scenic and elegant setting for weddings, corporate gatherings, and private celebrations. Surrounded by the Sahyadri ranges, lake views, landscaped spaces, and heritage-inspired architecture, the resort creates a memorable backdrop for every occasion. 

From intimate wedding functions and family celebrations to corporate offsites, leadership meets, retreats, and curated private events, DurgBhumi blends warm hospitality, thoughtful planning, and a naturally beautiful environment to make every event truly special.

items.title: Weddings & Family Celebrations
